name: Autumn Leaves
description: A mosaic in leaf colours: russet, gold, plum and moss.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Tiles in autumn leaf colours, shown on Creative Toy.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Make a picture, or just play with the colours.
howToPlay: Click the canvas, or move with the arrow keys and press Space, to place a tile.
Pick a colour with the number keys or the round swatches.
Press Undo to take the last tile back, or Clear to start over.
tips: Mirror symmetry makes leaf-like patterns almost by accident.
Your picture stays on this device and cannot be exported.
